subtitle: DbState is a developer and database release tool for understanding database state.
The Workspace section tells DbState where the local project repository is.
Health checks whether the DbState service and local environment are available.
Check Workspace validates whether the selected folder is usable as a DbState workspace.
Repo Status shows the Git state of the workspace.
Init Plan previews the project structure that DbState plans to create.
Source and Target defines what DbState will inspect or compare.
The connection is used for inspection and comparison. DbState reads metadata for review.
Compare Options control what DbState does after inspection or comparison.
Preview Repository Sync shows what repository changes DbState would create without writing files.
The Results section shows inspected objects, comparison status, planned operations, and warnings.
The Results table is the main navigation point for reviewing database state.
Object Diff explains exactly what changed for the selected object.
Selected JSON Item shows the structured JSON behind the selected object.
Warnings show issues that may affect release safety or review quality.
Release Plan turns compare results into a release-oriented review.
Dry-run previews the release plan without changing the database.
Release Context describes the environment and basis of the release plan.
Risk Summary gives reviewers a quick view of release risk.
Object Summary groups the plan by object type and status.
Release Candidates are objects or changes identified as possible items for release.
Generated Artifacts can include summaries, SQL files, manifests, risk reports, and structured JSON.
Generate Release Artifact writes selected release outputs into the repository for review.
Reports and Raw JSON provide the structured output behind the UI.
Raw JSON can support reviews, internal documentation, checks, dashboards, and future integrations.
DbState does not directly apply changes to PostgreSQL. It prepares reviewable artifacts.
Inspect. Compare. Review. Generate artifacts. Release with control.
